summary: CHOPPAH, a breakbeat chopper firmware: a break is cut into sixteen slices on the white keys, with momentary effect pads on the black keys and a generator that rearranges the break as it plays. Built on fm1-base; early status.
features: Eight built-in breaks incl. AMEN, THINK and APACHE; 16 slices each
Eleven held pads: rolls, reverse, freeze, tape stop, gate, dub throw
Four-slot master effects chain in any order, plus effects per slice
16 patterns with 32 break steps and kick, snare and hat lanes
Synthesised four-layer gabber kick; tap tempo and mixer
MIDI notes play slices and drums; looper and song mode not yet done

headings: choppah: an amen chopper for the m-vave fm-1
